subject: Your 2-minute fix for 20-minute spirals
preview_text: How to stop your 3AM spiral in 2 minutes flat — a trick our users swear by.
body_paragraphs: At 3AM, your brain is a liar. It tells you the breakup was your fault, that you'll never heal, and that checking their profile will give you closure. We've seen 600+ users fight that same battle, and the ones who win do something simple: they don't fight for 20 minutes.

Here's the truth: heartbreak hijacks your time. You spend 20 minutes replaying conversations, 20 minutes crying in the shower, 20 minutes doom-scrolling their Instagram. But what if you could cut that to 2 minutes? Our data shows that users who use the emergency mode cut their spiral time by 80%. They press one button, and a custom coping strategy—built for your breakup type—stops the train before it derails.

That's the feature I'm talking about: Emergency Mode. It's not just a timer—it's a 2-minute audio exercise that rewires your focus. One user told me, 'I used to waste an hour on my ex before bed. Now I hit emergency mode, do the breathing exercise, and I'm asleep in 5 minutes.' You've got it in your app right now. It's saved 40% of recovery time for others. It can save yours.

Open Fresh Start: Breakup Therapy tonight, and when the spiral starts, tap 'Emergency Mode.' Don't let a 3AM thought steal your tomorrow. P.S. The exercise changes based on your mood—so the calmer you log, the shorter it gets. Your 2-minute fix is waiting.
